props.title: Kzoo Makers Pricing
props.description: Kzoo Makers membership pricing - Affordable makerspace access in Kalamazoo, MI. Membership is just ($5/month), addon tools with Clean Side Tools ($20/month), or Everything Tools ($60/month). Access woodshop, metal shop, lasers, 3D printers, and more. Join our nonprofit maker community today.
